title: Constrain voice cleanup to the upload directory (#1044)
body: Refs #1044. Repairs the existing cleanup path findings surfaced by #1371. Cleanup now uses the configured upload directory, refuses upload paths outside it, and removes only the exact random upload name and dotted sidecars. Adds outside-directory and unrelated-prefix regression tests. Seven cleanup and partial-transcription tests passed; full CI is required before merge. No security alerts are dismissed or suppressed.
interface: The merged change for PR #1377 is covered by test/voice-upload-cleanup.test.js.
why: Additional real merged-fix benchmark case selected to broaden the agentic coding evaluation.
